Product information:
Product Overview
This men’s business striped suit is designed for professionals who value both sharp style and comfort. Crafted from a wrinkle-resistant synthetic fiber blend, it features a slim fit and a fused‑lining construction that ensures a crisp silhouette while remaining easy to care for—making it the perfect choice for business meetings, weddings, and other formal occasions.
Specifications
Material: Polyester (synthetic fiber blend)
Style: Business formal
Fit: Slim
Thickness: Standard
Suitable Season: Spring/Autumn
Available Color: Caramel Brown
